notes.title: Beautiful Mystic Defenders - Bug fixes and game balancing
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855902/811ab8cb8e661cba7d77481018750d2a7e3e6d23.png[/img]
Dear everyone! Thank you very much for supporting the game and contributing to the amazing launch that Beautiful Mystic Defenders had. Our game was featured on the front page of Steam for about a week, which is a dream come true for us!

And thanks to everyone's valuable feedback and bug reports, we have made the following bug fixes and game balancing in the current release.

Gameplay changes:
[list]
[*] Player can now refund upgrades for towers and heroines.
[*] Bile Launcher now deals hybrid damage and has a stronger slow effect.
[*] Balancing prices and power of several towers.
[*] Sumi's bombs can now stack and only last a limited time.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game is stuck when the first dialogue is played.
[*] Fixed a bug where Sumi and Airi couldn't move over their bombs and swamps.
[*] Fixed a bug where save files can't be deleted.
[*] Fixed a bug where the sound/music disappears after the game is played at high speed.
[*] Fixed a bug where air enemies block the player from selecting a tower.
[*] Fixed several translation issues.
[*] Other small bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Development Update
notes.notes:
Dear beloved players,

We, the BMD devs, have been working passionately over the last few months to address players' feedback and improve the game. Here is the list of updates that are in our latest demo build:
[list]
[*] Various aspects of the game (map, UIs, battle) have been visually improved.
[*] More upgrades and better upgrades can be obtained from the Upgrade screen.
[*] Balancing gameplay elements: heroes, strength, towers, bosses, etc.
[*] Improvement to how the story and dialogues are presented.
[*] Fully voice-acted adult scenes.
[*] Gallery feature implemented.
[*] Three Save slots.
[*] Fixes for various bugs reported by players.
[/list]

We have also been working on localizing the games to different languages and they are currently awaiting translation.

We hope you enjoy the content of this update and will keep on supporting us!

Please let us know your feedback here, in the group discussion, or on our Discord server https://discord.gg/NgtacRPTfy

Best wishes,
Fantasize Games Studio

notes.title: 【Lewd Formosa】New Game release
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/a5834554502bef2cbc952fe97c4858a3388d96fb.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1528560/

The game is a simulation game mainly with the fox demon Vivi. You will spend 30 days together.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/d94f30052f0d5a0dcc98cde17f5e7b285ed5b6dd.png[/img]

Four actions can be carried out with the fox demon Vivi in a day.
Action commands include "Talk", "Interact", "Go out" and "H".

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/e187459784bf5c0090b5f38ed914e56c4695c52b.jpg[/img]

Take her to various unique places to play and increase the positive feelings toward each other.
Talk with her to understand her past and uncover her secrets…

As the days pass by, you can unlock more special plot events with Vivi.
There are also many different Hentai events in the game. You can do various positions with Vivi.

But remember, living with a demon means you might see other demons along the way...
